# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in ControlPAD Controller:

1. **Do not open a public issue.**
2. Report the vulnerability privately by opening a [Security Advisory](https://github.com/NsPowEr/ControlPAD-Controller/security/advisories/new) or contacting `@NsPowEr` directly via GitHub.
3. Include detailed steps to reproduce the issue, the affected platform/version, and any relevant logs or packet captures.

We will review reports promptly and publish patches in subsequent releases.
